title: m2w-model (model.json)
description: The decoder described independently of any framework: dimensions, layer types, RoPE per layer type, tokens. Everything a graph cannot see (RoPE tables, sliding windows, EOS) is resolved here by the compiler.

architecture.description: the Hugging Face architecture string, e.g. Qwen3ForCausalLM

vocab.description: the real vocabulary: argmax / sampling look at the first `vocab` logits only

vocab_padded.description: what the lm_head graph computes (a multiple of 128; padded rows dequantize to 0)

rope.description: layer type -> RoPE of the layers of that type

group_size.description: int4 quantization block size along the input channels

tensors.description: role -> Hugging Face tensor name (templates with {i}); only the compiler reads this

vision.description: Qwen3.5 only: the image tower the package carries (images only). Absent = a text-only package

out_hidden.description: width of an image token = the hidden size of the text decoder

temporal_patch_size.description: a single image is repeated over it

merge_size.description: merge_size^2 patches become one image token

pos_grid.description: side of the learned (pos_grid x pos_grid) position embedding table, resampled to every grid at compile time

image_token_id.description: <|image_pad|>: the prompt holds one per image token

image_prompt.description: what the chat template writes for an image: the runtime expands the pad token to one copy per image token

mrope.description: Qwen3.5: the 3-position rotary of the full attention layers; text tokens use t = h = w = position, image tokens their (t, h, w) (python protocol.rope_tables_mrope / protocol.ts ropeTablesMrope)

section.description: frequencies per position axis (t, h, w)
